text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: One day, as I'm passing by the park...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So, do you like it, Taiki?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it tastes good! Hoo boy has it<n>got a bitter kick
to it, though!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Shucks, I'm tryin' ta think how them<n>fancy folk'd
describe it. You sure<n>brew a mighty fine "cuppa!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Why, thank you for saying so.<n>♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. That's right. Taiki and I<n>decided to have
one at the park<n>today.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It's an outdoor tea party! I'm havin'<n>a blast!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Which reminds me! I brought some<n>donuts to
enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Betcha this'll solve that lil' bitterness<n>problem!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sit tight while I go get 'em.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: SWEET MOTHER OF MERCY!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: A wasp! And a darn big one, too!<n>AAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh... it's just a bee. Perhaps the<n>sugary scent of
the donuts drew it<n>here?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Help me, Grass! HEEEEELP!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, I can take care of this. The best<n>thing to do is...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, I can take care of this. The best<n>thing to do is...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very true. As long as we stay<n>still and don't
disturb the bee...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ooh... So, make like statues and we'll<n>be safe?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, perfectly safe. So try to calm<n>down, okay,
Taiki?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We follow Grass Wonder's<n>instructions and sit
completely still.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Bzzz...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wow! Graaaass! We ain't goners<n>after all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Back when I was a kiddo in the<n>States, I was
taught not to mess<n>around when a killer bee's in
town.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Bees tend to stay where<n>it's sunny, so
why don't we move<n>into the shade?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
A-all righty. Then let's shake a leg<n>like we're
runnin' a race. Ready?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, no, Taiki. We have to move slowly<n>so as not to
disturb the bee.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! So we gotta be silent like a<n>ninja?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, like that. Now is your chance to<n>be a ninja,
Taiki. So, let's do our best.<n>♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Gotcha! I'm Ninja Shuttle, sneaky<n>and silent!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Eeeeasy does it...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The three of us make it to a safe spot.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Whew. Everything is okay now.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Back when I was a kiddo in the<n>States, I was
taught not to mess<n>around when a killer bee's in
town.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That was so scary! My knees are<n>tremblin' even
now!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Bees in the States sometimes cause<n>serious
incidents, so it's no surprise<n>many children are
afraid of them.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's a fact! Grass's approach was<n>wonderfully
perfect!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm glad you saw it that way. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Know thine enemy, as the saying<n>goes. It's
precisely because they are<n>scary that I learned as
much as I<n>could about them.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: There is nothing to fear as long as<n>you have a plan.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Grass! That's a tasty cuppa<n>wisdom ya
poured!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure I'd use that exact<n>phrasing...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder's level-headed<n>strength was on full
display this<n>afternoon.
